query: select jsonb_build_object('observed_at',now(),'schedule_runs',(select jsonb_agg(t) from (select status,operation_mode,count(*) as count,max(created_at) as latest_created_at,max(error_code) as example_error_code from public.prospecting_schedule_runs group by 1,2) t),'wa_akg_provisioning',(select jsonb_agg(t) from (select state,count(*) as count from public.wa_akg_seller_provisioning_jobs group by 1) t),'wa_akg_webhooks',(select jsonb_agg(t) from (select processing_status,count(*) as count from public.wa_akg_webhook_events group by 1) t),'recent_ana_runs',(select jsonb_agg(t) from (select status,error_code,count(*) as count from public.agent_runs where created_at>now()-interval '7 days' group by 1,2) t),'pg_net_last_hour',(select jsonb_agg(t) from (select status_code,count(*) as count,max(created) as latest from net._http_response where created > now()-interval '1 hour' group by status_code) t)) as summary;
